verdict: NO COURT WAS HELD. Refutability scored UXIN 4/10 on court-worthiness and court_runner.py routed it straight to ADJUDICATE by design (>=6 goes to COURT_RED, 4-5 goes to ADJUDICATE for the session to decide the borderline, <4 is killed). So there is no red or blue bench to weigh - the refutability triage IS the record, and the convictions below are the triage score, not bench convictions. The triage classes UXIN DAMAGE-ARRIVING and the reasoning holds up. Gross margin is 7.0% in Q1'26, flat against 7.0% a year earlier and 6.8% in Q4'25, but the company's OWN Q2 guide embeds RMB1,050-1,100M of revenue on 18,000-19,000 units, which is roughly RMB58.1k per unit against RMB64.9k in Q1 - a 10.5% sequential ASP decline that matches the industry's stated 10-15% two-month correction in mainstream used-ICE prices. On a principal, inventory-owning model, that price damage lands on a 7.0% margin. Volume damage is absent (the guide is +78% YoY on units) but the guide breaks an eight-quarter streak above 110% growth: against the Q2'25 base, Q2'26 implies +63% revenue and +78% volume, down from +112.9% and +119.1% in Q1. Growth is halving and it is sourced entirely to price. The triage explicitly checked and REFUTED a widely-repeated secondary claim that would have flipped the verdict - the 'shareholders diluted over 38x in the past year' line circulating on Simply Wall St is wrong for this window; weighted-average ordinary shares went 58.28bn to 66.44bn, or +14.0%, so revenue per ADS still compounded about +87%, and the 1:300 ADS ratio has been effective since 2024-01-11 so it does not contaminate the drawdown either. That is good work and exactly the kind of check that should be routine. The load-bearing risk is solvency, not the cohort narrative: cash of RMB47.4M (about US$6.9M) against RMB314.8M of short-term borrowings, current liabilities of RMB745.3M against current assets of RMB589.2M for negative working capital of RMB156.1M, and an accumulated deficit of RMB20.0bn. Of the US$50M subscription (NIO Capital affiliates US$20M plus Prestige Shine US$30M) at US$2.859 per ADS, only US$15M has closed, leaving US$35M unfunded at a strike 123% above the US$1.28 tape. The triage reads that honestly rather than bullishly - the price was set pre-collapse and was near-market on 06-29, so it is forward funding RISK, not evidence a strategic paid a premium; likewise the CEO's 10b5-1 plan ceiling of US$2.85 is simply non-binding now, not a conviction signal. Neither decisive variable is resolvable before the print: whether gross margin held near 7% through a 10% ASP decline needs the 09-29 print, and whether Prestige Shine funds the remaining US$30M is a private negotiation. The tape closed $1.28 on 2026-08-07, +26.7% on the day and +42.9% off the $0.896 low, so there is no discount left to press blind into a going-concern balance sheet. Under the response taxonomy this is a business-risk size cut to zero plus a timing objection, correctly routed to a dated tripwire rather than a court.
